hints.tr: `None` ise `True`. `low` varsa ve `node.value <= low` ise `False`; `high` için tersi.
hints.en: `True` if `None`. If `low` is set and `node.value <= low`, `False`; the opposite for `high`.

hints.tr: Sonra `is_bst(node.left, low, node.value) and is_bst(node.right, node.value, high)`.
hints.en: Then `is_bst(node.left, low, node.value) and is_bst(node.right, node.value, high)`.
